Specification: This module is a thin wrapper that adds Apalache type annotations to the original cf1s_folklore specification via an INSTANCE declaration. It declares integer constants and state variables corresponding to message counts, faulty-process counts, per-process program counters, and received-message counters. This file itself contains no top-level operator definitions, actions, assumptions, temporal formulas, or proofs.
